_meta.scope: London public leisure (council / trust operators) and boutique-premium studios. Commercial chains (PureGym, Virgin Active, David Lloyd etc.) are covered in a separate file.
_meta.sourceRule: Every figure below was read off the operator's own website or the council's own website on 9 September 2026. No comparison sites, no affiliate roundups.
_meta.headline: The public-leisure story is not membership price - Better in Lambeth is £60 a month, dearer than most commercial chains. The story is pay-as-you-go swimming (£3.20-£6.40 a swim) and residency (a Kensington resident's PAYG card is free; a Camden non-resident pays £109.40 a year for the same card).
_meta.schemaNote: brands[] uses the agreed shared schema. poolsOfNote, boroughResidency and gaps are supplementary.

brands.monthlyFrom: £34.25 (Phoenix Fitness Centre, Hammersmith & Fulham - single centre adult)
brands.monthlyTo: £72.00 (UK-Wide adult, any centre); £135.00 UK-Wide + Spa and Racquets
brands.cheapestClub: Phoenix Fitness Centre and Janet Adegoke Swimming Pool, W12 - £34.25/mo single centre, £39.45 multi-centre
brands.dearestClub: Vauxhall Leisure Centre, Lambeth - £60.00/mo single centre. Chelsea Sports Centre £59.50. Glass Mill / Forest Hill / Wavelengths (Lewisham) £55.70. Britannia (Hackney) £55.00.
brands.joiningFee: £12.50 setup fee on all monthly memberships. £0 on annual prepaid and on all Pay As You Go cards.
brands.contract: No minimum term on monthly memberships ('we won't tie you into a long term contract'). Annual prepaid memberships are excluded from the no-contract promise. Prepaying a year costs 11 months' worth at most centres - Britannia single centre is £605/yr against £55/mo (£660).
brands.pool: Yes - 53 London Better centres have a swimming page on Better's own site, plus Kentish Town Sports Centre (pool listed in facilities) and West Reservoir (open water). Full list in poolsOfNote and betterLondonPools below.
brands.offPeak: Off-peak memberships at most centres, typically £6-£11/mo below anytime: Kensington £39.00 vs £49.00; Britannia £45.00 vs £55.00; Cally Pool £32.00 vs £40.00; Crystal Palace £39.00 vs £50.50. Off-peak hours are roughly Mon-Fri 09:00-16:00 and after 13:00 at weekends, but each centre sets its own - London Fields Lido calls 06:30-09:00 and 16:00-21:00 peak on weekdays.
brands.multiSite: Three tiers: Single Centre, Multi-Centre (all facilities in your borough/district), UK-Wide (200+ centres). At Britannia: £55.00 / £64.10 / £72.00. Multi-Centre is not available at every centre - Vauxhall, Glass Mill, Forest Hill and Wavelengths sell single-centre only.
brands.freeze: Not published on the public membership pages. Flagged as a gap.
brands.cancellation: No minimum term on monthly memberships; annual prepaid memberships cannot be left early. Some products carry a 'month in hand' flag in GLL's own membership API, so check whether the product you pick charges a month up front.
brands.payAsYouGo: Two separate things, and they are not the same. (1) A Pay As You Go card - a one-off ANNUAL fee that buys up to 30% off every booking, price set by borough: £0 in Kensington & Chelsea and Hillingdon for residents, £28.00 Richmond, £30.00 Copper Box, £38.50 Waltham Forest, £41.50 Lewisham/Newham, £49.70 Hackney, £50.00 Crystal Palace, £54.10-£54.35 Camden residents, £56.00 Greenwich, £75.00 Lambeth, £81.90 Islington. (2) Day passes: £15 one day, £30 seven days, £54.95-£75 thirty days at most centres - but £25/day at Oasis, £20/day and £90/30 days at Jubilee Hall Gym, and £41/day and £110/30 days at Charlton Lido. Single swims for a non-member run £3.20 (Crystal Palace off-peak) to £11.50 (Charlton Lido).
brands.residentPrice: Kensington & Chelsea resident adult PAYG card £0.00/yr; resident concession £0.00; resident junior £0.00. Hillingdon resident adult PAYG card £0.00/yr; swim peak £5.55, off-peak £4.65; outdoor lido £8.00. Camden resident adult PAYG card £54.10 (Swiss Cottage) / £54.35 (Kentish Town, Oasis); resident senior 60+ card £6.90; Camden resident 60+ swims FREE off-peak. Hackney residents under 18, over 60, disabled or carers swim free all year with a PAYG card at Britannia, Clissold and King's Hall. Greenwich One Card at Charlton Lido: £9.50 adult swim, £5.75 in the 10:00-11:00 and 16:00-17:00 windows.
brands.nonResidentPrice: Camden non-resident adult PAYG card £109.40/yr - exactly double the resident price; non-resident senior £45.85 against £6.90 for a resident; non-resident junior £22.05 against £7.15. Kensington & Chelsea non-resident adult £37.00 against £0.00; non-resident junior £21.00 against £0.00. Hillingdon non-resident swim peak £6.40 (resident £5.55), off-peak £5.15 (£4.65), outdoor lido £11.40 (£8.00). Hackney charges residents and non-residents the same £49.70.
brands.borough: Barnet, Bexley, Brent, Camden, Croydon, Ealing, Enfield, Greenwich, Hackney, Hammersmith & Fulham, Harrow, Hillingdon, Islington, Kensington & Chelsea, Lambeth, Lewisham, Merton, Newham, Richmond, Sutton, Waltham Forest, Westminster (boating base only), plus Crystal Palace NSC and Covent Garden.
brands.buriedTerm: The Pay As You Go card is priced by residency and the gap is enormous - a Camden non-resident pays £109.40 a year for the card a Camden resident gets for £54.10, and a Kensington & Chelsea resident gets free. Second: the 'Flex' membership advertised at £10/mo on Better's national page prices at £12.50/mo in the actual join flow, plus a £12.50 setup fee, and buys one free booking a month. Third: at Vauxhall a non-member swim is £9.25 but £6.50 with a PAYG card - the card pays for itself in a handful of swims, and nothing on the poolside tells you that.
brands.source: https://www.better.org.uk/memberships ; per-centre https://www.better.org.uk/leisure-centre/london/<borough>/<centre>/prices ; live membership prices from GLL's own join site memberships.better.org.uk and its API better-admin.org.uk/api/memberships/types

brands.dearestClub: London Aquatics Centre, Stratford - MOVE+ £42.99/mo, YOU+ £52.99/mo
brands.joiningFee: Currently £0 - the join flow shows 'Join today and pay no joining fee' at both Porchester and the London Aquatics Centre. A standing £1 joining-fee promotion also runs on the national site. Normal joining fee is not published while the promo is live.
brands.contract: No contract. But you pay a 'Final Month in Advance' at sign-up - Everyone Active's own FAQ says this 'covers a calendar months' notice period at the point you cancel'. On the Porchester swim membership that made today's payment £40.00 against a £30.00 monthly fee. 14-day money-back guarantee on memberships only.
brands.pool: Yes at most. London Aquatics Centre has TWO 50m pools plus a diving pool with 1m-10m platforms and dry diving. Porchester Centre has a 30m four-lane main pool and a 20m teaching pool. Marshall Street, Moberly, Queen Mother Sports Centre, Little Venice, Jubilee Sports Centre and Seymour are the other Westminster sites.
brands.offPeak: Not offered as a named tier in the online join flow at Porchester or the Aquatics Centre. Off-peak pricing appears on pay-as-you-go activity prices instead - LAC adult swim £7.90 peak, £7.30 off-peak.
brands.multiSite: MOVE+ covers your centre plus every Everyone Active site on the same or a lower adult rate. YOU+ Ultimate covers all 230+ centres nationwide plus Hot Yoga, FORTIS and spa.
brands.freeze: Yes - you can freeze a direct-debit fitness or swim membership; submit the freeze date by the 20th for the following month. The first direct debit cannot be frozen because it contains the pro-rata charge.
brands.cancellation: Cancel in your profile area. Cancelling the direct debit at the bank cancels every membership you hold. Cancelling after the 20th may be too late for that month's collection. The month paid in advance at sign-up covers the notice period.
brands.payAsYouGo: Register free for an Everyone Active card and book casually. London Aquatics Centre published prices: swim £7.90 peak / £7.30 off-peak (concession £5.70 / £4.50); gym £15.00 (concession £8.75); fitness class £14.40 (concession £13.00); Atlantis inflatable session £12.00 adult, £9.00 concession/junior. Everyone Active's own FAQ says the break-even is twice a week: 'if you intend to visit the centre at least twice a week then a membership will normally be the best value option'.
brands.residentPrice: Westminster's centres are Everyone Active's main London cluster but no resident/non-resident split appears in the public join flow - flagged as a gap.
brands.nonResidentPrice: Not published in the join flow - see gaps.
brands.borough: Westminster (Seymour, Marshall Street, Moberly, Porchester, Queen Mother, Little Venice, Jubilee Sports Centre, Paddington Recreation Ground), Newham/Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park (London Aquatics Centre), Harrow (Harrow Leisure Centre), Havering (Harrow Lodge), Barking & Dagenham.
brands.buriedTerm: The London Aquatics Centre is run by Everyone Active, not GLL/Better - its own site is copyright 'Sports & Leisure Management Ltd' and its Join Online button goes to joinonline.everyoneactive.com. A lot of London gym guides still file it under Better. Second: the 'no contract' claim sits alongside a compulsory month-in-advance payment that you only get back as a notice period, not as cash.
brands.source: https://www.everyoneactive.com/join-membership/ ; https://londonaquaticscentre.org/memberships-and-prices/activity-prices/ ; live prices from joinonline.everyoneactive.com (siteid 0153 Porchester, 0330 London Aquatics Centre)

brands.residentPrice: Wandsworth's Access for All scheme, resident-only and substantial: FREE 6-month membership (off-peak and weekend gym and swim) for anyone on Universal Credit, Jobseeker's Allowance, Housing Benefit, Council Tax Support, Disability Living Allowance or Incapacity Benefit; FREE 1-year membership for children on free school meals, covering one adult and up to two children; FREE 1-year Premium membership for Wandsworth foster carers, up to 4 juniors added; £20/month Premium membership for care leavers aged 16-25; FREE swimming for ALL under-8s accompanied by an adult; free 5-day swimming lesson courses each school holiday for non-swimmers aged 6-12 at Balham, Latchmere, Tooting and Putney.
brands.nonResidentPrice: Full Flexi rates - £47.00/mo Premium at Putney. The Access for All offer is 'open to Wandsworth residents only'.
brands.borough: Wandsworth (Balham, Latchmere, Putney, Roehampton, Tooting, Tooting Bec Lido, Wandle Recreation Centre), Kingston (Chessington Sports Centre, Malden Centre, Tolworth Recreation Centre, Weir Archer Athletics and Fitness Centre)
brands.buriedTerm: Wandsworth's Access for All memberships are free but expire - the Universal Credit membership runs 6 months and you must re-prove eligibility with documents showing payment within the last 28 days. And the free tiers are off-peak and weekends only; peak access is an upgrade (£23.50/month on the free school meals membership).

brands.cancellation: Not published on the join page - flagged as a gap.
brands.payAsYouGo: 1-to-1 swim coaching £35 a session; 1-to-1 PT £40 a session. Casual swim and gym prices are not on the join page - flagged as a gap.
brands.residentPrice: FREE. Southwark Council's own page: 'Southwark residents can use the swimming and gym facilities for free in all of our leisure centres' - all day Friday, Saturday 14:00-17:30, Sunday 14:00-21:00, Silver sessions all week for over-60s, and 7 days a week at all Move Southwark centres for eligible disabled residents. Register with proof of ID and home address. This is the single best-value swim in London and almost nobody writes about it.
brands.nonResidentPrice: Full membership rates (£39.49-£61.49/mo) or casual rates. The free scheme is residents only.
brands.buriedTerm: The free swim and gym is real but it is time-boxed - Friday all day, and two weekend afternoon windows. Turn up on a Tuesday evening and you pay. Concession eligibility is wide (60+, 16-19, full-time students, emergency services, armed forces, council staff, selected benefits) but needs proof on your first visit.

brands.contract: No contract. A 'Be Well For Now' membership runs from 1 day upwards.
brands.pool: Five pools in the borough, four open. St George's Leisure Centre pool is closed pending a rebuild. If your home centre's pool is shut you can use any other Be Well pool in the borough.
brands.offPeak: Be Well Flex £36.60/mo - Mon-Fri 09:00-16:00 and after 13:00 at weekends. Be Well Concession £34.40/mo on the same off-peak hours.
brands.multiSite: Every membership covers all six centres.
brands.freeze: Not published - flagged as a gap.
brands.cancellation: Not published - flagged as a gap.
brands.payAsYouGo: Badminton: £49.00/mo for up to 8 sessions, or £299 for 50 sessions over 12 months. Casual swim and gym prices are not on the memberships page - flagged as a gap.
brands.residentPrice: FREE SWIMMING for Tower Hamlets residents, and the scheme has just been widened: women and girls aged 16 and over (register any time), residents aged 55 and over, men aged 35 and over (registration opened 1 April 2026, sessions bookable from 6 April 2026), and a parent-and-child option letting an adult resident member bring up to two children free at designated family swim sessions. Proof of age AND proof of Tower Hamlets residency required at a centre to activate.
brands.nonResidentPrice: Full rates: Be Well Anytime £44.45/mo, Flex £36.60, Concession £34.40, Junior (11-16) £21.95, Disability £15.00, Anytime plus spa £99.00, The Spa £65.00.
brands.buriedTerm: Free swimming is confined to designated session times for each group - it is not open access. And the council's own swimming page still leads on a consultation that closed on 12 January 2022, so the borough's public information about St George's is years out of date even though the pool is still shut.

brands.brand: Hampstead Heath swimming (City of London Corporation)
brands.monthlyFrom: n/a - season tickets only, from £83 for 6 months (Bathing Ponds, adult)
brands.monthlyTo: £348 for 12 months (Lido and Bathing Ponds combined, adult)
brands.cheapestClub: Bathing Ponds - £5.00 adult single, all year round
brands.dearestClub: Parliament Hill Lido in summer - £8.80 adult for a morning or afternoon session
brands.contract: None - pay on entry during non-bookable sessions
brands.pool: Yes, and these are the famous ones. Parliament Hill Lido is a 60-metre open-air, unheated, chlorinated pool open 365 days a year. Kenwood Ladies' Pond, Highgate Men's Pond and Hampstead Mixed Pond are natural bathing ponds, open all year, deep and opaque, competent swimmers only.
brands.offPeak: Yes and it is dramatic. Lido summer: Breakfast session £5.00 adult, Morning and Afternoon £8.80, Evening £5.00. Swimming an hour earlier or later halves the price.
brands.multiSite: Season tickets sold for the Lido alone, the Ponds alone, or both.
brands.freeze: n/a
brands.cancellation: n/a - pay as you go
brands.payAsYouGo: Bathing Ponds all year: adult £5.00, concession and under-16 £3.00. Lido winter: adult £5.00, concession and 16-17 £3.00, junior 5-15 £1.50. Lido summer by session: Breakfast £5.00 / £3.00 / free for 5-15s; Morning £8.80 / £5.20 / £2.70; Afternoon £8.80 / £5.20 / £2.70; Evening £5.00 / £3.00 / n/a (adults 18+ lane swimming only). Sauna, winter only (October-May), £7.00 - and it cannot be bought without a swim ticket. Season tickets: Lido 6 months £171 adult / £102 concession, 12 months £252 / £152; Bathing Ponds 6 months £83 / £50, 12 months £157 / £94; both 6 months £216 / £130, 12 months £348 / £209. Prices valid to 31 March 2027.
brands.residentPrice: No residency test. Under-16s and over-60s swim FREE before 09:30 on production of proof of age, at the Lido and at all three ponds.
brands.nonResidentPrice: Same as residents - this is a City of London Corporation open space, not a borough facility.
brands.borough: Camden (managed by the City of London Corporation)
brands.buriedTerm: The free swim before 09:30 for under-16s and over-60s applies every day of the year and is almost never mentioned. And the £8.80 summer Lido price only applies to the Morning and Afternoon blocks - the Breakfast and Evening sessions are £5.00, so a 07:00 or a 19:00 swim costs 43% less than the same swim at 11:00. Concession eligibility is wide and is documented in detail: 60+, Universal Credit, JSA, PIP, Carer's Allowance, Attendance Allowance, Guardian's Allowance, Housing Benefit, War Widow(er)'s Pension, disability, students, 16-18 in education.

brands.monthlyFrom: £257 (Canary Wharf, City, Moorgate, Wood Wharf - single club)
brands.cheapestClub: Canary Wharf, City, Moorgate and Wood Wharf - £257/mo single club
brands.dearestClub: Mayfair and Chelsea are not sold as single-club at all - the lowest tier that includes them is £299/mo. Of the clubs that do sell single-club membership, Islington, Marylebone, Soho and The Whiteley are dearest at £287/mo.
brands.joiningFee: £100 on single-club and on the £299 Mayfair-and-Chelsea tier; £200 on the all-clubs tier
brands.contract: Monthly membership needs a minimum of one full calendar month's notice and cancellation takes effect at the end of the FOLLOWING month - so leaving costs you up to two months. Fixed Term (12-month) memberships also exist; cancelling one early gives a pro-rata refund excluding any discounts originally applied.
brands.pool: Yes at 11 of 17. Battersea 20m performance pool; Canary Wharf 20m; City 20m; Islington 20m; Marylebone 16m three-lane; Richmond 20m; Soho 20m four-lane, ozone-treated, with a suspended glass training floor above it; Tower Bridge 20m three-lane; Wimbledon 25m; The Whiteley three-lane; Wood Wharf 20m. NO swimming pool at Mayfair, Moorgate, Chelsea, Clapham Junction, Queens Park or Paternoster Square - Chelsea has a cold plunge only, Queens Park a hydro pool for 25, Paternoster Square a hydro pool for 14.
brands.offPeak: Not offered.
brands.multiSite: £345/mo for all 17 clubs, £200 joining fee. Access to new clubs is staggered by waitlist and your confirmed access date is only given on joining.
brands.freeze: Yes, at a fee. On 12-month Fixed Term memberships the freeze fee is paid in advance by card and the term is extended by the number of frozen months.
brands.cancellation: One full calendar month's notice, effective at the end of the following month. Cancelling the direct debit does NOT constitute notice and is treated as non-payment, triggering debt recovery. Club Credit expires one year after being added, or on the cancellation date if sooner, and cannot be exchanged for cash.
brands.payAsYouGo: None published - Third Space sells membership only, no day passes or class packs on the public site.
brands.buriedTerm: Cancelling the direct debit at your bank is not notice - Third Space's own terms say it 'will be treated as nonpayment, triggering the debt recovery process'. And notice runs to the end of the month AFTER the month you give it, so a resignation on 2 October keeps you paying until 30 November.
brands.source: https://www.thirdspace.london/clubs/ (per-club pages carry the price and joining fee) ; https://www.thirdspace.london/membership-terms-conditions/

paygVsMembership.note: Rob's question: does pay-as-you-go beat a membership, and at what frequency? Worked from the operators' own published figures.
publicLeisure: Britannia Leisure Centre, Hackney. Single-centre membership £55.00/mo plus a £12.50 setup fee. A swim with a PAYG card is £4.55 and the card is £49.70 a year. Two swims a week for a year = 104 x £4.55 + £49.70 = £522.90. The membership over the same year = £660 + £12.50 = £672.50. PAYG wins by £150. The membership only pulls ahead at about three visits a week, and only if you also use the classes and gym.

Vauxhall, Lambeth. PAYG card £75/yr, swim £6.50 off-peak. Two swims a week = £751. Membership £60/mo = £720 + £12.50. Roughly a dead heat at twice a week; the membership wins from about 2.5 visits a week. Lambeth is the one borough where the membership is the better buy for a twice-a-week swimmer.

Crystal Palace. Non-member off-peak swim is £3.20 with no card at all. Two swims a week = £332.80 a year against a £50.50/mo membership (£606 + £12.50). PAYG wins outright and you never need the card.

Everyone Active says it plainly in its own FAQ: 'if you intend to visit the centre at least twice a week then a membership will normally be the best value option for you'. On Better's own numbers that is optimistic for swimmers - the crossover is nearer three visits a week in most boroughs.

The cards themselves need the same arithmetic. A Hackney PAYG card at £49.70 saves £1.85 a swim, so it needs 27 swims a year to break even. A Kensington & Chelsea resident card is free and breaks even instantly. An Islington concession card at £38.50 needs about 16 swims.
boutique: The boutique studios have already done this calculation for you and the answer is always the membership - which is why every membership carries a minimum term. Psycle: a single credit is £29, but PSYCLE15 is £15.67 a class. 1Rebel: £26 a session, or £14.58 on the All-Access 12. Heartcore: £35 a class, or £22.14 on the 14-class membership. SoulCycle: £28 a class, or £19.50 on the 16-class membership.

The catch is symmetric: memberships do not roll over. Psycle's credits die at the end of the billing period. SoulCycle's 16-class membership expires 30 days from purchase. Heartcore's top-ups must be used in the same month. So the effective per-class price is only real if you actually go that often, and the studios know most people will not.

For anyone going less than twice a week, the packs are the honest choice - but read the expiry. 1Rebel's 10-pack lasts 5 months; Psycle's credits, Heartcore's 10-pack (3 months) and SoulCycle's 10-pack (3 months) are all shorter than they look.
